comment: The modulo test is written `steps % i - output_offset + 1 == 0`, which by C precedence reduces to `steps % i == 0` for jack index i running 1 to 8, so the jack printed n divides by n+1. The step count wraps at 8, so divisors that do not divide 8 (3, 5, 6 and 7) give an uneven pattern rather than a steady division. The README documents a reset input that the module does not have.
